title: A job queue loses claims and drops counts under eight workers
spec:
OBJECTIVE
src/jobs.py is a small in-process job queue used by eight worker threads. Under load, two workers sometimes claim the same job, the processed counter under-counts, and shutdown occasionally hangs. Make it correct under concurrency without serialising the workers onto one thread.

FILES
src/jobs.py only. Do not modify tests/.

INTERFACES
JobQueue.put(job_id: str) -> None
JobQueue.claim() -> str | None      returns a job id exactly once per job, or None when the queue is empty
JobQueue.done(job_id: str) -> None  marks a claimed job finished; increments the processed counter
JobQueue.processed -> int           number of done() calls
JobQueue.close() -> None            after close, claim() returns None and waiting claimers wake up
Stats.record(key: str, value: int) -> None ; Stats.total(key: str) -> int   exact sums under concurrent record()

CONSTRAINTS
- Each job id is returned by claim() exactly once across all threads.
- processed equals the number of done() calls exactly.
- claim() may block briefly waiting for work but must return None promptly after close().
- Stats totals must be exact under concurrent writers.
- Python stdlib only (threading is fine). Keep the public interface.

VERIFY
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q

REASONING
as invoked
